description: This Java class implements a metrics tracker for a connection pool, specifically for monitoring HikariCP connection pool metrics within the Apache Fineract project. It tracks various connection metrics such as acquire time, usage, creation, and counts of active, idle, pending, max, and min connections, and integrates with Micrometer for metrics collection.

classes.name: TenantConnectionPoolMetricsTracker
classes.description: A class that tracks and reports metrics related to a HikariCP connection pool for a specific tenant, using Micrometer.

methods.name: TenantConnectionPoolMetricsTracker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes various timers, counters, and gauges for tracking connection pool metrics, tagged with tenant and pool name.

methods.name: recordConnectionAcquiredNanos
methods.description: Records the time taken to acquire a connection in nanoseconds.

methods.name: recordConnectionUsageMillis
methods.description: Records the duration of connection usage in milliseconds.

methods.name: recordConnectionTimeout
methods.description: Increments the counter for connection timeouts.

methods.name: recordConnectionCreatedMillis
methods.description: Records the time taken to create a connection in milliseconds.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Removes all registered metrics from the MeterRegistry.
